item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover the coastal areas and the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Friday. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week and early next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night over inland areas will be rather large.

Date/Month: 01/01 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
